subject.title: feat(ui): custodian onboarding surface with option cards and first-run handoff

question: Should first-run model setup permanently hand users into the new custodian conversation rather than the existing chat/dashboard flow once the session and route-state defects are fixed?
rationale: This PR introduces a new onboarding destination and interaction model rather than repairing an established broken contract; the protected maintainer label indicates that the product direction needs explicit human approval.

options.title: Sponsor the custodian handoff
options.body: Approve the new first-run destination after the two state-management fixes and real browser proof demonstrate the intended handoff.

options.title: Keep the existing landing flow
options.body: Retain the custodian route as an optional deep link or defer it until the onboarding redesign direction is explicitly accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the custodian handoff
recommendation.body: Approve the new first-run destination after the two state-management fixes and real browser proof demonstrate the intended handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR evidence ties this author to the onboarding plan and implementation, though broader current-main ownership tracing remains incomplete.
